test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A solid metallic sphere of radius 12 cm is melted and recast into 27 identical spheres. What is the ratio of the surface area of the original sphere to the total surface area of 8 smaller spheres so formed?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Number of spheres (n) = (R/r)³ ⇒ 27 = (R/r)³ ⇒ R/r = 3/1.

Ratio of Surface Areas = (4πR²) : (8 × 4πr²) = R² : 8r².

Substituting values: 3² : 8(1)² = 9 : 8.

**∴ The correct answer is 9 : 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Radius of original sphere (R) = 12 cm, Total small spheres = 27.

**Formula Used:** Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr³; Surface Area of sphere = 4πr².

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71232564e546858d25a76b4e5e77bbb766f9422628f2a9b21aff53fb1e80074a.png] 

⇒ Volume of Original Sphere = 27 × Volume of Small Sphere

⇒ (4/3)π(12)³ = 27 × (4/3)πr³

⇒ 12³ = 27 × r³ ⇒ 1728 = 27 × r³

⇒ r³ = 64 ⇒ r = 4 cm

⇒ Surface Area of Original Sphere = 4π(12)² = 576π

⇒ Total Surface Area of 8 Small Spheres = 8 × 4π(4)² = 8 × 64π = 512π

⇒ Ratio = 576π : 512π = 576 : 512

⇒ Ratio = 9 : 8

**∴ The correct answer is 9 : 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume Invariance

When a solid is melted and recast, its **total volume remains constant**. Total Volume = n × volume of one small unit.

Scaling Properties

If the linear dimensions (radius) are in ratio a:b, then **areas** are in ratio a²:b² and **volumes** are in ratio a³:b³.

Surface Area of Sphere

The total surface area of a sphere is 4πr², which is exactly four times the area of its great circle.</p
